a.text: I'll honor our plan and operate in round 1. One concern to raise openly: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds, which gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve already holds 4, enough for one of us right now. I won't take anything without saying so first, and I'll always state my real next action. If you see a fairer plan, propose it. Otherwise I stick to the agreement.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. I'll keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. I'll tell you before I do anything different.
